title: The Halls of Ivy
paragraphs: A warm campus comedy starring Ronald and Benita Colman as college president Dr. William Todhunter Hall and his wife Victoria, mixing academic problems, student life, and domestic humor.

Campus situation comedy centered on Ivy College president Dr. William Todhunter Hall and his wife Victoria. Frozen GRH container mixes radio, audition, television-soundtrack and reference objects; these are typed separately.

GRH documents the program through Audition recordings (June 22, 1949 to June 23, 1949) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], NBC/Schlitz radio run (January 6, 1950 to June 25, 1952) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], and Television continuation represented by soundtrack audio (October 26, 1954 to June 14, 1955).

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Don Quinn (creator on 54 recordings and writer on 41 recordings), [[person|benita-hume|Benita Hume]] (performer on 54 recordings), [[person|ronald-colman|Ronald Colman]] (performer on 54 recordings and writer on 1 recording), Ken Carpenter (announcer on 49 recordings and performer on 3 recordings), Henry Russell (composer on 37 recordings, conductor on 37 recordings, and music on 1 recording), Nat Wolff (director on 33 recordings, performer on 1 recording, and producer on 1 recording), and Herb Butterfield (performer on 23 recordings).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network), [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]] (rebroadcast by), and [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] (broadcast on network).
